edits.rationale: GitHub documents exchanging a GitHub OIDC token for a Google Cloud access token via Workload Identity Federation. Atlas's Workload Identity Federation is a separate setup: you register a workload identity provider in the Atlas Federation Management console, connect it to an organization, and add database users with assigned privileges. Nothing in the Google Cloud setup does any of this, so configuring Google Cloud alone does not configure Atlas access. The last point is an inference from the two documented procedures.
